messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ऐसा बना दिया मुझे वह बिन‑शांति का दैत्य, जो, मेरे विरुद्ध आते हुए, धीरे‑धीरे मुझे पीछे धकेल रहा था उस जगह जहाँ सूरज मौन है।

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Hindi) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | tal | demonstrative adjective “such” | ऐसा | such | OK | | mi (1) | 1st‑person singular clitic pronoun “me” | मुझे | me | OK | | fece | verb, causative “made” | बना दिया | made | OK | | la | definite article “the” | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | bestia | noun “beast” | दैत्य | beast | OK | | sanza | preposition “without” (part of *sanza pace*) | बिन‑ (in बिन‑शांति) | without | OK | | pace | noun “repose / peace” (part of *sanza pace*) | शांति (in बिन‑शांति) | peace / repose | OK | | che | relative pronoun “that” | जो | that | OK | | venendomi | gerund “coming on against me” | मेरे विरुद्ध आते हुए | coming against me | OK | | ’ncontro | preposition “against” | विरुद्ध | against | OK | | a (1) | preposition in idiom “a poco a poco” (incremental) | — (merged into “धीरे‑धीरे”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | poco (1) | adverb “little” (incremental) | — (merged into “धीरे‑धीरे”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | a (2) | preposition in idiom “a poco a poco” (incremental) | — (merged into “धीरे‑धीरे”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | poco (2) | adverb “little” (incremental) | — (merged into “धीरे‑धीरे”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | mi (2) | 1st‑person singular clitic pronoun “me” | मुझे | me | OK | | ripigneva | verb “was pushing back” (imperfect) | धकेल रहा था | was pushing | OK | | là | adverb of place “thither” | उस | that | OK | | dove | relative adverb “where” | जहाँ | where | OK | | ’l | definite article “the” | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | sol | noun “Sun” | सूरज | Sun | OK | | tace | verb “is silent” | मौन है | is silent | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `la`, both occurrences of `a`, both occurrences of `poco`, and `’l` – these function as articles or prepositions that Hindi does not require; their meaning is conveyed by other words or by the compound “बिन‑शांति” and “धीरे‑धीरे”. - **MISSING / WRONG / GRAMMAR**: none.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 58** - Original: ऐसा बना दिया मुझे वह बिन‑शांति का दैत्य, - Issue: none - Corrected: ऐसा बना दिया मुझे वह बिन‑शांति का दैत्य,
- **Line 59** - Original: जो, मेरे विरुद्ध आते हुए, धीरे‑धीरे - Issue: none - Corrected: जो, मेरे विरुद्ध आते हुए, धीरे‑धीरे
- **Line 60** - Original: मुझे पीछे धकेल रहा था उस जगह जहाँ सूरज मौन है। - Issue: none - Corrected: मुझे पीछे धकेल रहा था उस जगह जहाँ सूरज मौन है।
